items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: Mr. Coward used to frequent the Dorchester all the time... I used to sing different songs, and I guess he just thought my voice was all right and asked me to do 'Two Cigarettes in the Dark,' which I did.

ctx.x: Did you do that song, "Two Cigarettes in the Dark?"
I introduced it for Noel Coward.
